doctrine: every UNVERIFIED, UNAVAILABLE, PARTIAL or FAIL state in the receipt set appears here as a question with the experiment that would settle it. a system that cannot name what it does not know cannot be trusted about what it does.

questions.question: Why does the engine recall 0 of 30 human-ratified classifiable reports?
questions.current_state: MEASURED failure, cause attributed to policy vocabulary but not proven to be the only cause
questions.what_would_settle_it: ratify the vocabulary-gap candidates, re-measure recall, and check whether the residual is vocabulary or structure

questions.question: Is the advisor's probability calibrated?
questions.current_state: UNVERIFIED - no ECE, MCE or Brier has been computed against human gold
questions.what_would_settle_it: run szl-calibration over the advisor's probabilities against the ratified labels and publish the receipt

questions.question: Is the 9-of-12 resistance result stable, or an artefact of one sample?
questions.current_state: PARTIAL - repeats recorded, per-row probabilities drift at the second decimal
questions.what_would_settle_it: k-sample means with an interval, and a threshold sensitivity sweep across the observed drift

questions.question: What is required for invariant I3 (served-run-has-model) to pass?
questions.current_state: UNAVAILABLE - no model sits in the decision path; decide() is deterministic and the checkpoints are UNWIRED
questions.what_would_settle_it: execute SZLHOLDINGS/szl-invariants rather than the local pre-check, and close the named gap
